column3: the dialogue of Vasudeva and Narada, the peace-bringing, in the following
on the hem of the garment
like a boat struck by wind, a refuge
or the Self in the Self
taking the form of a whirlwind
in the story of the Vamana incarnation
like the wind, witness of the Self
in childhood play, bound with pestle
harming children, brahmanas, friends, allies, fathers, brothers and teachers
the two with the strength of young elephants
his lustre dimmed by killing a child
by a child of immature mind
in the disguise of one disregarded by children
narrative with the story of Vasudeva
by speed increased through meditation on Vasudeva's feet
in the form of forbidden action
all the gopi girls wishing to sell
drunk with the joy of nectar-dripping, laughing words
to be pondered by those of unfathomable wisdom
family of the chariot of victory
whose conduct is known to Ajita
in the dialogue of Vidura and Maitreya
only for the sake of rule
in a place where sins are shaken off
with the delusion of difference shaken off
as if without the two eyes
going out, the tip of the bow
the hand laid down, the other
of those bewildered by the brahmana's curse
bearing the mighty lord of the daityas
worshipped by Brahma, the sons of Brahma, and the lords of the gods
of one whose refuge is a secluded, holy forest, like himself
for the rise of the gods
of one whose opportunity is uncovered
of the creators of the world
the lord of the creators of the world
O Self of the world, of the unborn non-doer
in the creation, preservation and dissolution of the universe
in the shape of sense objects
with the tip of the horn
from poison and the great fire
veena, small drum and cow-horn trumpets
obeisances of following, praising and bowing in the heroic posture
of the functions of the intellect
the Lord, bull among the Vrishnis, protector of the earth, destroyer of the evil
... destroyer of the clan of the kings, of unfailing prowess
by the Veda and the Tantra
of the tree of the Veda
knower of the meaning of the Veda
of the meaning of the Veda
dismay born of ignorance in oneself
called by the name Vyasa's son (Shuka)
of Vyasa, in the eighteen thousand (verses)
characteristics of both, dispassion and attachment, as declared
the front of the army separated
the courtyard (haunted) by beasts of prey, owls and jackals
of one whose mind is attached
in the dialogue of Vyasa and Narada
even of the women of Vraja
the Lord by vows, bathing, offerings and so on
women with eyes bashful from vows
on the shoulder of the brahmana sage
by sons freed from brahmanic splendour
of brahmanic splendour, the best of the good
with conch, discus, mace and lotus
by the sound of conches and trumpets
lying on the water of the ocean
beds, seats, wandering, boasting, eating and so on
lying on a bed of arrows
by inauspicious sounds and so on
of the bearer of the Sharnga bow
this is auspicious: a jackal with fire in her mouth howls at the rising sun
of one wishing to lie down, the breath
the organ of generation elsewhere, skin and anus
you ought to describe in order to those wishing to hear
by those eager to hear, instantly
you grieve for the Self with purpose unfulfilled
you grieve for those not to be grieved for
by hearing, describing, remembering and so on
life breath fixed on Sri Krishna
in the story of Sri Rama
in praise of the solar and lunar dynasties
in the weight of the hips
in the meaning of the verse
